sloka: स्वशरीरं त्वया पुष्टं कुर्वता तप उत्तमम् ।अनुप्तं रोहते श्वेत न कदाचिन्महामते ।। ७.७८.१५ ॥
transliteration: svaśarīraṁ tvayā puṣṭaṁ kurvatā tapa uttamam ।anuptaṁ rohate śveta na kadācinmahāmate ।। 7.78.15 ॥

translations.english: O great-minded and white one, your body, which you nourished through excellent penance, will not grow back once consumed, just as something unsown never sprouts.
